abilities.name: Lightless Step
abilities.description: You can walk through total darkness without stumbling, sensing walls and drops a pace ahead.
abilities.cost: A pounding headache once you are back in the light

abilities.name: Air Taster
abilities.description: Taste the air in a tunnel and sense whether it is safe to breathe for the next hour.
abilities.cost: Bad air makes you cough for a while

growth.grows: how faint a danger and how far ahead

abilities.name: Rockfall Ear
abilities.description: Hear stone groan and know a few seconds early when a ceiling is about to fall.
abilities.cost: Constant small noises keep you from sleeping deep

abilities.name: Chalk Mark Memory
abilities.description: Mark a tunnel with chalk and you can always find your way back to that mark.
abilities.cost: Only one mark at a time stays in your head

abilities.name: Fungus Lore
abilities.description: Touch a cave mushroom and know whether it heals, feeds, poisons or glows.
abilities.cost: One touch each; some spores make you itch

growth.grows: how rare a fungus you know

abilities.name: Squeeze Through
abilities.description: You can fold yourself through a gap half your width, as long as you breathe out first.

abilities.name: Deep Breath
abilities.description: Hold your breath long enough to swim a flooded passage of a dozen paces.
abilities.cost: Dizzy and weak for a minute after

abilities.name: Trap Smell
abilities.description: Smell oil, rust or old blood near a trap before you step on it.
abilities.cost: Useless with a cold or in smoky air

abilities.name: Glowworm Lamp
abilities.description: Call cave glowworms to gather on your hands and give enough light to read by for an hour.
abilities.cost: They leave a sticky trail; only in caves that have them

abilities.name: Depth Sense
abilities.description: Know how far below the surface you are, and which way is up, even after falling.
abilities.cost: Deep places press on your ears until you climb

growth.grows: how precise and how deep it works

abilities.name: Monster Lair Sign
abilities.description: Read claw marks, bones and droppings and know what kind of creature lives ahead.
abilities.cost: Takes a minute of crouching in the dark

growth.grows: how rare a creature you recognise

abilities.name: Last Torch
abilities.description: When your light runs out, you can keep a dying torch burning for one more hour.
